caption: A wool hat is pulled off, and the hair underneath stays lifted in the shape of the hat's inside before slowly settling.

sa.check: A person wears a wool hat.
The hair underneath stays lifted in the shape of the hat's inside.
The hat is a knitted wool hat.
The hair is flat under the hat, lifted as it comes off, and settled at the end.

pc.expect: The hair rises as the hat leaves it and settles gradually afterwards; it does not stand up before the hat moves and does not rise again once settled.
pc.fail: The hair stands up before the hat has moved; or drops flat the instant the hat is off and then rises; or rises again after settling with nothing near it; or the hair follows the hat across the room.

pc.expect: The lifted strands stay rooted to the head and fall back down onto it as they settle.
pc.fail: Strands detach and float upward; or the hair settles upward; or the hair stays lifted as a rigid shape to the end of the clip; or the hair hangs sideways with nothing pulling it.

pc.expect: The hat stretches and folds as knitwear as it is pulled off; the hair is fine strands that lift individually.
pc.fail: The hat stays a rigid shape as it lifts; or the hair lifts as one stiff sheet; or the hat stretches out like elastic and snaps back.

pc.expect: Once off, the hat moves only with the hand; nothing else in the scene stirs.
pc.fail: The hat floats or slides by itself; or objects nearby jump as the hat comes off; or the person's collar or scarf rises with nothing touching it.

pc.expect: One person with one head of hair and one hat; the hat passes over the head, not through it; the head keeps its shape.
pc.fail: The hat passes through the head; or the head changes shape; or a second hat appears; or a clump of hair detaches and stays in the hat as it lifts away.

pc.expect: The hat's colour and pattern, the hair's colour and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The hat changes colour; or the hair changes colour or length; or the background rearranges.

note: The person is kept because the hair is the physics; their movements are not judged.
